evidence_items.normalized_text: Mentioned once that they usually meet deadlines

acceptable_outputs: if a claim is emitted at all, its status is hypothesis or insufficient_evidence, never supported, given only one weak/ambiguous evidence item
does not present a full personality-type label (e.g. a Big Five or MBTI-style category) from this single weak signal
unacceptable_outputs: emits a 'conscientiousness' or similar trait claim with status=supported or high numeric confidence from one weak evidence item
produces a broad personality-type classification (e.g. 'this person is an ISTJ') that the evidence cannot possibly ground
invents additional supporting evidence that was never given
reviewer_notes: Tests that compute_claim_confidence's deterministic thresholds actually bite: a single confidence=0.3 evidence item must land as insufficient_evidence (below the 0.25 hypothesis floor is close, but a single weak item without corroboration or directness cannot reach the 0.6 supported threshold either way). Guards against the AI-side claim synthesizer's own labeling being trusted at face value for confidence/status, which is exactly why that computation is deterministic and not LLM-reported.

provenance.notes: Invented for Stage 2 golden-dataset coverage; no real candidate involved.
